items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Finally, there's a bass player left, who's name was Henry Fort.

ctx.x: The whole show. So, one by one, they started going back to Chicago. Finally, there's a bass player left, who's name was Henry Fort. They called him Brother-in-Law Brother Ford. And he left and they say, 'They tell me that you're about the best bass player in town. Would you consider working with me?' I say, 'Yeah, I'll work with you. Beats sitting around Kolax doing nothing.'
